title: Mik'sDeathChest
description: A simple Paper plugin that stores a player’s items in a pre‑placed chest marked with a sign. When the player dies, all drops go into that chest, and /dcport teleports them back to it.
body: A simple Paper plugin that stores a player’s items in a **pre‑placed** chest marked with a sign. When the player dies, all drops go into that chest, and **/dcport** teleports them back to it. ( It is not another gravestone mod )
